newsitem.title: CHINA: Lai Sun Dev details US$150 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Lai Sun Dev details US$150 mln bond issue.

text.p: Lai Sun Development Co Ltd said on Monday it had proposed to issue US$150 million convertible bonds and to grant an option to increase the bond issue by up to US$20 million.
The bonds will be issued at 100 percent of the principal amount and will bear interest at a rate of four percent per annum payable annually, the company said in a statement.

The bonds will carry the rights to convert into Lai Sun shares at a conversion ratio of HK$11.50 per share subject to adjustment. The bonds may be redeemed on August 4, 2000 at 115.2249 percent of the principal plus accrued interest.
Application has been made to list the bonds on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange, it said.

The net proceeds of the bonds of about US$145.85 million prior to the exercise of the option or US$165.35 million after the exercise of the option will be used to repay debts and for general working capital, it said.
Lai Sun said it would issue 114.58 million new shares, or 9.7 percent of its enlarged share capital, on full conversion of the bonds including the option.
Jardine Fleming International Inc is the lead manager of the issue.
The bonds issue is subject to shareholders approval in an extraordinary general meeting to be held on July 30, it said.
Lai Sun shares fell HK$0.40 to HK$8.80 in late Monday morning.
